short_claim: Fishing on lake ice requires an independent safety assessment; unknown ice = stay off.
Angling license or exemption and lake-specific rules must be checked.
evidence_type: Legal/regulatory, verify at time of use

short_claim: The 4-inch guideline is for new clear ice only and does not authorize crossing.
Without safe access and proper tools, equipment-free through-ice fishing should not be attempted.
evidence_type: Editorial safety inference from guidance; needs specialist signoff

short_claim: No improvised ice-hole construction method is recommended.
evidence_type: Conservative editorial decision, not published DNR prohibition

short_claim: Ice varies greatly within a single water body.
White ice is roughly half as strong as clear new ice; appearance never proves strength.
Shoreline and transitions can be weak despite central ice.
Report ice immersion to emergency services; witnesses should avoid entering weak ice.
Self-rescue includes facing entry route, kicking horizontally and rolling or crawling away.
Emergency rewarming and medical assessment require qualified clinician guidance.
